Now I see the issue more clearly. The job started at 01:00:04Z and was killed at 02:00:04Z due to the activeDeadlineSeconds of 3600 seconds (1 hour). The job is processing 95 batches and at batch 69, it hadn't completed within the hour. However, there are also SMTP connection errors trying to send notification emails to 10.20.4.18:587, which are failing.

Let me search the Kubernetes documentation to understand CronJob and Job deadline behavior better.
